title: PALOMA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Model Fit

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model fit by measuring and comparing perplexity on corpora representing African-American English versus White-aligned English (using the TWITTERAAE dataset).

Measuring language model perplexity on fringe community corpora (Manosphere, Gab, 4chan) to assess model fit to discourse characterized by high prevalence of toxicity, hate speech, and masculinist ideologies.
